programs.showName: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
programs.description: Zero, and evil scientist, decides to capture the Pokémon Giratina, the ruler of a parallel universe. Later, in order to save himself and his world, Giratina enlists the help of Ash and his team.

programs.showName: Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life
programs.description: Arceus is betrayed by a few villagers. However, when he returns to take revenge, Ash Ketchum and his friends are sent back in time to reverse the event.

programs.showName: Pokémon 3 the Movie: The Spell Of The Unknown
programs.description: Ash Ketchum and his friends journey to the beautiful mountain town of Greenfield in order to save Molly Hale, where they encounter a mysterious Pokémon.
